neighbours.label: A new sentence that opens, right after a full stop, with a subjectless continuation of the previous one: 'Also known as / Also called …' or 'Resulting <noun> …' (fires on the opener's second piece: ' known', ' called', 'ing')
fire: Platelets are tiny fragments that circulate in the blood. Also known as thrombocytes, they clump together to seal a wound.
The software merges several scans into one file. Resulting documents can be searched by keyword.
This pigment gives carrots their orange colour. Also called provitamin A, it is converted in the liver.
The reaction releases a large volume of gas. Resulting pressure can crack a sealed container.
The aurora appears near the magnetic poles in winter. Also known as the northern lights, it draws thousands of tourists.
The kiln fires the clay at very high temperatures. Resulting tiles are hard enough to walk on.
The tibia is the larger of the two bones in the lower leg. Also known as the shinbone, it carries most of the body's weight.
Sodium bicarbonate reacts with acid to make bubbles. Also called baking soda, it is found in most kitchens.
quiet: Platelets, which are also known as thrombocytes, are tiny fragments that clump together to seal a wound.
The software merges several scans into one file. The documents can then be searched by keyword.
This pigment gives carrots their orange colour. It is also called provitamin A and is converted in the liver.
The reaction releases a large volume of gas. This pressure can crack a sealed container.
The aurora appears near the magnetic poles in winter. Many people know it as the northern lights.
The kiln fires the clay at very high temperatures, and the resulting tiles are hard enough to walk on.
The tibia is the larger of the two bones in the lower leg. People usually call it the shinbone.
Sodium bicarbonate reacts with acid to make bubbles. Most kitchens have a box of it.

notes: Card: mixed sentence-initial tokens. Probes: 'Resulting pictures' 0.95, 'Also called' 0.71 of max; imperatives 'See', 'Pick' ~0.26; 'Commonly referred' 0.23; 'Reported yields' 0.06; the same words mid-sentence ~0.06. So narrower than 'any sentence opener'. Pole is weak (max 6.66).
